tasks.title: The Human Microbiome
paras: The human microbiome consists of trillions of microorganisms living in and on our bodies. These include bacteria, viruses, fungi, and other microbes. They play a pivotal role in functions such as digestion, immunity, and mood regulation. For instance, gut bacteria help break down food and produce essential vitamins.

Recent studies show that the microbiome can be influenced by diet, lifestyle, and medication. Antibiotics, while effective against harmful bacteria, can disrupt the balance of beneficial microbes. This disruption can lead to health issues like digestive problems and weakened immunity. Researchers are exploring the connection between the microbiome and mental health. Certain gut bacteria produce neurotransmitters affecting brain function. An imbalance in these bacteria may be linked to conditions like depression and anxiety.

Maintaining a healthy microbiome involves eating a varied diet rich in fiber, reducing stress, and avoiding unnecessary antibiotics. Bacteria that aid digestion, known as robotics and prebiotics, are also beneficial. As understanding of the microbiome grows, it may lead to breakthroughs in treating diseases and improving health.

questions.stem: The word “pivotal” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型： 词汇题 原文定位： “They play a pivotal role in functions such as digestion, immunity, and mood regulation.” 正确答案分析： “pivotal” 意为 “关键的、重要的”，在上下文中，微生物群落在消化、免疫和情绪调节等功能中发挥着核心作用，后文 “肠道细菌帮助分解食物、产生必需维生素” 也进一步印证了其重要性。因此 “very important”（非常重要的）是最接近的含义。 选项分析： (A) very important 非常重要的 —— 正确，与 pivotal 语义一致，符合上下文语境。 (B) possible 可能的 —— 无关，文中未体现 “可能性” 相关含义。 (C) combined 结合的 —— 无关，无法体现微生物群落的核心作用。 (D) unwelcome 不受欢迎的 —— 语义相反，文中强调微生物群落的积极作用。

questions.stem: What is one way antibiotics can affect humans?

options.A: They enhance the production of neurotransmitters.
options.B: They can weaken immunity by harming beneficial microbes.
options.C: They can help relieve digestive problems.
options.D: They make it easier to produce essential vitamins.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 细节题 原文定位： “Antibiotics, while effective against harmful bacteria, can disrupt the balance of beneficial microbes. This disruption can lead to health issues like digestive problems and weakened immunity.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确提到，抗生素虽然能对抗有害细菌，但会破坏有益微生物的平衡，这种破坏会导致免疫力下降等健康问题。选项 B 正是对这一内容的同义转述，因此正确。 选项分析： (A) They enhance the production of neurotransmitters. —— 错误，文中提到 “某些肠道细菌产生神经递质”，与抗生素无关。 (B) They can weaken immunity by harming beneficial microbes. —— 正确，与原文 “破坏有益微生物平衡，导致免疫力下降” 完全对应。 (C) They can help relieve digestive problems. —— 错误，文中明确说抗生素的破坏会导致消化问题，而非缓解。 (D) They make it easier to produce essential vitamins. —— 错误，文中提到 “肠道细菌帮助产生必需维生素”，抗生素会破坏这类细菌，不会促进维生素产生。

questions.stem: What connection are researchers exploring regarding the microbiome?

options.A: The link between gut bacteria and immunity
options.B: The role of fungi in mood regulation
options.C: The role of viruses in digestion
options.D: The link between gut bacteria and mental health

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型： 细节题 原文定位： “Researchers are exploring the connection between the microbiome and mental health. Certain gut bacteria produce neurotransmitters affecting brain function. An imbalance in these bacteria may be linked to conditions like depression and anxiety.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确指出，研究人员正在探索微生物群落与心理健康之间的关联，具体说明肠道细菌与抑郁、焦虑等心理问题有关。选项 D 准确概括了这一探索的内容，因此正确。 选项分析： (A) The link between gut bacteria and immunity —— 错误，文中未提及研究人员探索肠道细菌与免疫力的关联，免疫力是微生物群落的基本作用之一。 (B) The role of fungi in mood regulation —— 错误，文中提到微生物群落包括真菌，但未涉及 “真菌在情绪调节中的作用”。 (C) The role of viruses in digestion —— 错误，文中未提及病毒在消化中的作用，也未提及相关研究。 (D) The link between gut bacteria and mental health —— 正确，与原文 “探索微生物群落与心理健康的关联” 完全对应。

questions.stem: All of the following help to maintain a healthy microbiome EXCEPT

options.A: eating a varied diet rich in fiber

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型： 细节题 原文定位： “Maintaining a healthy microbiome involves eating a varied diet rich in fiber, reducing stress, and avoiding unnecessary antibiotics.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确列出了维持健康微生物群落的方法：食用多样化、高纤维的饮食、减轻压力、避免不必要的抗生素。选项 C “避免细菌来源” 未被提及，且微生物群落本身由细菌等微生物组成，避免细菌来源不利于维持其平衡，因此是例外选项。 选项分析： (A) eating a varied diet rich in fiber —— 正确，文中明确提及，是维持健康微生物群落的方法之一。 (B) lowering stress levels —— 正确，“reducing stress” 与 “lowering stress levels” 同义，是文中提到的方法。 (C) avoiding sources of bacteria —— 错误，文中未提及，且与维持微生物群落的理念相悖。 (D) reducing the use of antibiotics —— 正确，“avoiding unnecessary antibiotics” 与 “reducing the use of antibiotics” 语义一致，是文中提到的方法。

questions.stem: What is the relationship between paragraphs 2 and 3?

options.A: Paragraph 3 challenges the ideas proposed in paragraph 2.
options.B: Paragraph 3 provides examples of the disruptions mentioned in paragraph 2.
options.C: Paragraph 3 specifies how to achieve a healthy microbiome based on the factors mentioned in paragraph 2.
options.D: Paragraph 3 elaborates on the benefits of antibiotics mentioned in paragraph 2.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型： 段落关系题 原文定位（两段核心内容）：Paragraph 2： 提出影响微生物群落的因素（饮食、生活方式、药物），重点说明抗生素会破坏有益微生物平衡，同时提到研究人员探索微生物群落与心理健康的关联。Paragraph 3： 开头明确指出 “维持健康的微生物群落需要怎么做”，具体列出饮食、减压、避免不必要抗生素等方法，这些方法均对应第二段提到的影响因素（饮食、生活方式、药物）。 正确答案分析： 第二段介绍了影响微生物群落的相关因素（包括不利因素），第三段则基于这些因素，具体说明如何维持健康的微生物群落，因此两段关系是 “第三段基于第二段提到的因素，明确维持健康微生物群落的方法”，选项 C 正确。 选项分析： (A) Paragraph 3 challenges the ideas proposed in paragraph 2. —— 错误，第三段并未反驳第二段，而是在第二段的基础上给出解决方案，逻辑一致。 (B) Paragraph 3 provides examples of the disruptions mentioned in paragraph 2. —— 错误，第三段讲的是 “维持健康的方法”，而非 “破坏的例子”。 (C) Paragraph 3 specifies how to achieve a healthy microbiome based on the factors mentioned in paragraph 2. —— 正确，符合两段核心逻辑：介绍影响因素→说明对应维持方法。 (D) Paragraph 3 elaborates on the benefits of antibiotics mentioned in paragraph 2. —— 错误，第二段提到抗生素的负面影响，第三段未阐述其益处，反而建议避免不必要的抗生素。
